course_reviews_pending_is_undecided.name: course_reviews_pending_is_undecided
course_reviews_pending_is_undecided.value: "course_reviews"."status" <> 'pending' OR ("course_reviews"."moderated_at" IS NULL AND "course_reviews"."moderated_by_admin_user_id" IS NULL)

course_reviews_decision_has_moderator.name: course_reviews_decision_has_moderator
course_reviews_decision_has_moderator.value: "course_reviews"."status" NOT IN ('published', 'rejected') OR ("course_reviews"."moderated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "course_reviews"."moderated_by_admin_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

course_reviews_withdrawn_by_student.name: course_reviews_withdrawn_by_student
course_reviews_withdrawn_by_student.value: "course_reviews"."status" <> 'withdrawn' OR ("course_reviews"."moderated_at" IS NULL AND "course_reviews"."moderated_by_admin_user_id" IS NULL)

courses_online_no_location.name: courses_online_no_location
courses_online_no_location.value:
("courses"."format" = 'online' AND "courses"."city" IS NULL AND "courses"."location" IS NULL)
          OR ("courses"."format" <> 'online' AND "courses"."city" IS NOT NULL)

file_assets_activation_consistency.name: file_assets_activation_consistency
file_assets_activation_consistency.value:
("file_assets"."status" <> 'pending' OR "file_assets"."activated_at" IS NULL)
          AND ("file_assets"."status" NOT IN ('active', 'superseded') OR "file_assets"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)

refund_requests_feedback_len.name: refund_requests_feedback_len
refund_requests_feedback_len.value: "refund_requests"."admin_feedback" IS NULL OR (length("refund_requests"."admin_feedback") BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND "refund_requests"."admin_feedback" = btrim("refund_requests"."admin_feedback"))

refund_requests_decision_has_admin.name: refund_requests_decision_has_admin
refund_requests_decision_has_admin.value: "refund_requests"."status" NOT IN ('awaiting_provider', 'rejected', 'failed') OR "refund_requests"."reviewed_by_admin_user_id" IS NOT NULL

users_has_one_identifier.name: users_has_one_identifier
users_has_one_identifier.value: "users"."phone" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."email" IS NOT NULL

users_email_normalized.name: users_email_normalized
users_email_normalized.value: "users"."email" IS NULL OR ("users"."email" = lower(btrim("users"."email")) AND length("users"."email") BETWEEN 6 AND 254)
